bracket: [Textbook answer-key error in part (b), and the book's own part (a) is what convicts it. Part (a) fixes the reading: 60 claps per minute is one clap per second, and the printed \(340\) m/s follows from the sound covering \(2 \times 170\) m in that second. On the same reading 45 claps per minute is an interval of \(\tfrac{4}{3}\) s, so \(2d = 340 \times \tfrac{4}{3}\) and \(d = 226.67\) m. The printed \(255\) m would require an interval of \(1.5\) s, that is 40 claps per minute, not 45 — so the key and the stem cannot both stand. The solution above works from the stem as printed.]
